title: MedTrack
description: A healthcare tracking platform built with Next.js and MongoDB to manage and track medication schedules and symptoms efficiently.

title: Bloggy
description: A full-stack blogging platform that lets users create accounts, publish and edit blog posts, engage with content via likes and comments, and customize user profiles with avatar uploads.
features: Secure JWT authentication and password hashing with bcrypt
Interactive community feed with post liking and commenting
User profile management and image upload handling with Multer

title: EbUy
description: A full-stack MERN e-commerce platform featuring secure user authentication, a searchable product catalog, and interactive shopping cart management.
features: Full-stack MERN architecture for scalable e-commerce
Secure user authentication and protected routes
Dynamic product catalog with real-time shopping cart state

title: BoiKini
description: A modern book management application and personal reading companion that enables book enthusiasts to explore collections, manage reading lists and wishlists, and track reading goals with persistent local storage.
features: Smart sorting by page count and book ratings
Read list and wishlist tracking with LocalStorage persistence
Responsive design with interactive book details and custom routing
